bureau: registered credit bureaus (Central Bank of Lesotho)
note: The Credit Reporting Regulations, 2013 (Legal Notice 68 of 2013), Schedule B, the Central Bank of Lesotho's Credit Information Reporting Standards, read in the gazette as published: a consumer's payment profile may be displayed and used for credit assessment for five years from the date of the event; an adverse classification of consumer behaviour ('delinquent', 'slow payer', 'default') one year and of enforcement action two years, further listings the game doesn't model. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.
